question: Can the original ordered q/r halfwords be evaluated in the old even Fold and isolate a single endpoint for a physical reflected source test?
kills: The closed old q/r test requires a separately represented Ramond endpoint
Mixing the five old packets can annul the early arm of the m=-1 test
One old cover arc supports the m=2 integer charged endpoint
scope: Actual old Fold, five packets, two quarters and both orders. The m=2 physical rank-one test is conditional on transport of the same halfwords and on the actual common reflected positive form. The physical selection, weight, reference and full F1 operator map are uncomputed.
